purpose: The one checkpoint the project calls its walking controller, the requirement set it is judged against, and the evidence. A candidate becomes the controller only by replacing this file.
acceptance: c48_long meets the stage 2 commands, the stop and the stop tolerance under the follower in the surrogate. It exceeds the drift limit open loop; the closed loop corrects that drift. It is accepted because every input has a sensor on the robot and nothing better exists with that property.

controller.name: c48_long
controller.inputs: 231 proprioception, command and last-target values plus a 60-control gait clock; every input has a sensor on the robot

drift_per_hold_m.note: 7 of 8 walks over the limit, median 0.152; corrected by the follower in closed loop

stop_position_tolerance_m.note: worst of five 1 m routes in the surrogate, true pose, one trial each, before the file named its five routes; the file's routes are not yet judged on surrogate or native

not_judged: closed loop with a simulated Mid-360 odometry pose
disturbance: no noise, delay or randomization in training

compatibility_receipt.note: Renewed 2 November 2026; configs/approved_code_version.json reports whether the tree still matches it
